summary.one_liner: A Meetup group for engineers who work on reliability challenges for web-scale distributed systems, listed as the South Bay SRE Meetup in Sunnyvale, CA.
use_cases: Finding local SRE talks and discussions
Networking with reliability engineers in the South Bay
Learning how large distributed systems are run in production
Following SRE meetup events in Sunnyvale
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Meetup group for people who tackle reliability challenges for web-scale systems. The stated focus is on unique problems and solutions for running distributed systems at massive scale. The page text contains only this description and generic navigation, so it does not list specific events, speakers, schedules, or resources. The group is listed in the awesome-sre list under Conferences & Meetups as the South Bay Site Reliability Engineering Meetup in Sunnyvale, CA.
notable: Focused on reliability of web-scale distributed systems
Based in Sunnyvale, CA (South Bay area) per the awesome-sre listing
Listed in the awesome-sre Conferences & Meetups section
caveats: Page text is minimal; no event dates, schedule, or membership details are shown
Page title says NorCal while the URL and awesome-sre listing say South Bay
